notice.body: Workforce transparency for supplier cost recovery, security access governance, and contingent-workforce compliance. Not a performance-monitoring tool.

Placeholder — to be confirmed by Vodafone DPO (e.g. GDPR Art. 6(1)(c) legal obligation for AÜG compliance; Art. 6(1)(f) legitimate interest for licence recovery). §26 BDSG / §87(1) Nr. 6 BetrVG co-determination applies in Germany.

Identity (name, IDs, email), engagement (employer of record, supplier, SOW, assignment dates), cost (rates, salary — masked), IT access and licence entitlements. No content of communications, no productivity or activity scoring.
Mockup: synthetic data. Proposed: findings 24 months after closure; purpose log 36 months; raw feeds per source-system retention.
App roles EXEC, VPC_ANALYST, HR_LEGAL, CISO, WORKS_COUNCIL_VIEW. Compensation masked except HR_LEGAL. Row access by market. Every Person 360 open requires a stated purpose and is logged.
Aggregates only, minimum group size k ≥ 10, no individual drill-down, no names. Designed to support a Betriebsvereinbarung.
Mockup — synthetic data. Legal thresholds are configurable and flagged for validation by Vodafone Legal / labour counsel.
